Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_relation = '='. Require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, compound_records on record_id, docs on doc_id, and compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
